sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 233421, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: 2026 peak season (April 15 - October 14): standard electric/water site $30 a night; tent-only sites $20, group site $85. The same rates are posted for 2027.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233421/rates (Peak Season 2026-04-15 to 2026-10-14: STANDARD ELECTRIC 30, TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 20, GROUP STANDARD ELECTRIC 85), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233421 ('85 standard sites with water and electric hookups') + RIDB catalog (all 85 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites: Electricity Hookup 50, Water Hookup Yes; no sewer attribute), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 102 campsites: 85 electric/water sites and 17 tent-only sites, plus a group tent area. Catalog Max Vehicle Length on the electric sites runs 25-148 ft (most 40-75 ft); the longest look like pad lengths, so no maximum is recorded. 12 pull-throughs, 73 back-ins. Most sites have gravel bases.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233421 ('The campground offers 102 campsites, including 17 tents sites and 85 standard sites with water and electric hookups'; 'Most campsites have a gravel bases') + RIDB catalog (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry per site), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Flush and pit toilets. Boat ramp, swim beach, playground, basketball court, amphitheater; trailhead for the Overmountain Victory NHT.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233421 ('Amenities include flush and pit toilets, showers, drinking water and a dump station'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Camping 'only permitted to those who have a reservation' (recreation.gov, 877-444-6777, or the app); the gatehouse makes no changes. If no attendant is present, guests self-check in with a gate code emailed at booking. 14 nights in any 30 days. Check-in 3 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233421 (notices: 'Camping is permitted in designated campsites only, and only permitted to those who have a reservation', 'Maximum stay is 14 days within any 30 day period', check-in/out and gate-code notice; facility_rules maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233421 ('Golden Age/Access and America the Beautiful Interagency Senior and Access Passes are accepted at this campground. Cardholders receive a 50% discount on camping fees.'), read 2026-10-22

summary: USACE-run (not concession), reservation-only. Confirmed $30 (2026) base, 50-amp electric + water, reservable on recreation.gov. Added 102 sites with 12 pull-throughs, flush toilets/showers/water/dump, no first-come camping, 14-night max, senior/access 50% discount. Operating: April 2027 is open for booking. Not stated: sewer, a campground season statement (rate season Apr 15-Oct 14 not written), booking window, minimum stay. USACE district page answers 403 (Akamai) to plain HTTP.
